tours.name: Wildlife & Safari
tours.tags: Bentota · Udawalawe or Yala · Galle Fort
tours.route: Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) → Bentota → Udawalawe or Yala National Park → Galle → Colombo → Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)
tours.overview: Discover the best of Sri Lanka's wildlife and southern coastline on this exciting three-day adventure. Cruise through the tranquil mangrove forests of the Madu River, visit a sea turtle hatchery, and choose between Udawalawe National Park, renowned for its large herds of wild elephants, or Yala National Park, famous for one of the world's highest leopard densities. Complete your journey by exploring the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort and Sri Lanka's vibrant commercial capital before returning to the airport.
